control_flow: If the right light is below 60 (dim), steer by the line tracker; else go to avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if the left light is below 70, turn away from a left or right obstacle, else drive in the dark; else drive in the dark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70, drive forward; else go to stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, also in the dark inside a tunnel.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads below 60

bright, right light 60 or more: it goes to avoidWalls
